Please report these audit findings to the maintainers of Pygments and Requests; the output identifies those packages. If you believe the issue is in Rich itself, use the private reporting process in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
